corrections_this_clip_makes: The shake in the earlier clips was the camera swinging with the gecko's heading, not the ground sliding. Fixed azimuth removes it.
The gecko in tools/strike_clip.py was not walking badly -- it was commanded to hold position so the cricket would not bolt. The gait, body and checkpoint are unchanged.
